gates.description: Generator codegen engine: builds DSL + generator, runs tests (JaCoCo coverage), verifies deterministic generation (byte-identical across runs), and validates generated app structure.

RuntimeHost gate: generates a sample app, syncs runtimehost libs, runs the assembled app's test suite (JaCoCo coverage), and validates runtime surface evidence (controller allowlists, namespace convergence).

AI knowledge substrate gate: proves derived corpora cannot silently drift from sources, validates knowledge cards, runs failure-signature normalizer self-check, security pattern sweep, and all check-*.py static instruments (including coverage ratchet).
AI beta scenario gate: validates golden AI scenarios against scope policy, verifies scenario pack structure and model schema conformance.

Beta release evidence gate: evaluates 36 required reports from ~18 producer scripts against beta-release-gate-policy.json. Distinguishes precondition-unmet (exit 2) from check-failed (exit 1). Opt-in -GenerateReports runs producers first.
Beta0 final closure gate: verifies all beta-0 release blockers are resolved, checks evidence completeness, and validates closure criteria before final release.

T1 fast gate (Fast Lane): T0 checks plus generate + build + boot one frozen canary app (npdev-canary) with REST smoke (health, one flow, one panel), plus T1-scoped corpus checks. Target < 3 min. Records results to verification-cadence-state.json.

CI PR gate: runs on every pull_request. DSL checks (includes ReleaseGateValidatorTest), kernel inproc adapters, generator build+test, and RuntimeHost smoke via a real generated sample app's test task. Linux (ubuntu-latest).

Orchestrator: runs every quality gate in dependency order (generator -> runtimehost -> ai-knowledge -> beta-release) and reports one aggregate verdict. Beta-release deferred by default (T3 release-ceremony tier); opt-in via -IncludeReleaseGate.
